title.narrative: PFRU Partnership Fund for a Resilient Ukraine

description.narrative: PFRU Partnership Fund for a Resilient Ukraine supports liberated communities’ early recovery needs through community engagement, addressing local government capacity gaps, and strategically communicating results back to residents to sustain trust in state institution. Supporting local communities includes both supporting good consultation processes and dialogue and also supporting delivery of services and community work. Inclusion, and particularly of vulnerable groups in the processes and the project themselves is a main focus, and GEDSI (Gender Equality, Disability and Social Inclusion) is a central focus throughout the program. Conflict related sexual violence is another aspect that is relevant for several of the components in the program. The environmental challenges related to the concflict are becoming clearer, and managing these risks and well as improving the local enviroment remain central. Supporting transparency and accountability is an important part of the program and an important part of supporting trust in the local communities.
